changes: Default Codex execution uses the SDK-bundled CLI with explicit overrides preserved; no global installation or login change.
Existing Creative Director distinguishes model completion, retained prose, length goals, staged Diff candidates and author acceptance. Empty completion never marks a writing step complete.
Persistent fixed-step checkpoints retain partial prose after interruption or restart; unknown pre-restart timing requires an explicit author budget review.
Local next-step budget preflight and conservative future growth estimates preserve required sources, model choice and request limits.
Book delivery checks count current manuscripts or author-selected candidate versions once, validate source freshness, retain target history and never change writing statistics or Canon.
Optional scene intent and entry/exit conditions, explicit execution position and source-bound retained drafts strengthen sequential writing without a new planner.
Exact repeated long passages remain review pointers with real positions, never automatic literary verdicts or deletions; edited drafts do not claim old Diff/review results as current.
Preview: original isolated real-Codex/MCP drafting is author-directed and candidate-only; length targets do not prove literary quality or native GUI acceptance.
runtime_validation: Preview / PARTIAL: see the current delivery evidence; headless browser, local checks, real Codex/MCP and packaged workers are separate gates. No native GUI/IME/DPI acceptance is claimed.
features: Character assistants, Python SDK and Codex MCP reuse one typed Action Registry and existing domain services.
On-demand Python Control uses genuine CPython WASI in a bounded owned subprocess, without host project mounts, network or shell.
Real frontend receipts support chapter navigation, pinned references, layouts and actual editor state.
Project/persona-scoped scripts, output history, AI task provenance and explicit read-only result handoffs.
Existing Codex login, concrete models and supported effort/context controls; real task events, result reading, cancellation and supported live steering.
Frozen author confirmations remain valid after a model or Python turn ends; scripts are never automatically replayed.
Source and binary candidates exclude private manuscripts, credentials, conversation history and character assets.
Preview: the action catalog covers designated workflows, not every application operation; new controls primarily support Chinese and English.
name: Novel Studio
